summary_en: 400,000 shares (0.9% of S/O) to be acquired off-auction on 16 Jul 2026. Price ceiling ¥1,701/share (16 Jul close). Total authorised commitment ¥680.4M. Execution on Fukuoka exchange at 08:50 JST 17 Jul 2026, limited to that trading window only.
title_en: Notice regarding execution of treasury-share acquisition via off-auction trading on the Fukuoka exchange
translation_en_brief: Q-Papanets (Fukuoka Q-Board) announced on 16 Jul 2026 the terms of a single-day off-auction share buyback authorised at the 15 Jul 2026 board meeting. The company will acquire 400,000 shares (0.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) at ¥1,701 per share (the 16 Jul closing price), for a total of ¥680.4 million. The order will be placed at 08:50 JST on 17 Jul 2026 via Fukuoka exchange off-auction trading, limited to that trading window only. Execution is subject to order matching; partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be published after the 08:50 trading window closes.
